newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks May same store sales up 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks May same store sales up 6 pct.

text.p: Starbucks Corp on Thursday said its overall net revenues for the four weeks ended May 25 rose 37 percent from the year ago period, while same store sales increased six percent.
Overall net revenues rose to $74.2 in May from $54.2 in the same month one year ago, the company said in a statement.
Same store sales comprise revenues from comparable stores open for at least 13 months.
For 34 weeks ending May 25, 1997, net revenues were $598.0 million, up 39 percent from $429.0 million last year. Same store sales year-to-date rose five percent last year's levels.
